description: This file defines an interface `IPasswordHasher` for password hashing and verification, providing methods to hash a password and verify a password against a hash and salt.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: An interface for password hashing and verification, including methods for hashing passwords and verifying hash-salt pairs.

methods.name: HashPassword
methods.description: Hashes a password and returns a tuple containing the hash and salt.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies a password against a given hash and salt.
